label: Fetch Job Log
mcp_tool_description: Return a CloudBolt job's status, output, errors, outputs and its progress log (the last N progress messages), plus its direct child jobs and every failed descendant with their errors, so a failed job can be diagnosed in one call. For a sourcecodereposync job the per-object results are flattened into syncResults. Set log_file_tail to also read the last lines of the job's log file, which holds Python tracebacks. The caller must own the job or be a CloudBolt admin.
